$comment: Elementum · Reveal → Reading journey — the archetype template contract. Three field classes: (A) VOCABULARY — app-wide constants locked by DES_12/DES_08, identical for every user; (B) ARCHETYPE — locked per day-master stem (10 variants), identical for every user of that stem; (C) USER_CHART — computed per user by engine/energyRoles.js, never hand-authored. Every component in p6-journey.html binds only to these fields. Never invent vocabulary: any null archetype field is filled from DES_12's persona table, not improvised.

relation_nouns.$comment: Ten-god family relative to the user's core element → surface noun. One concept, one name (DES_08).

relation_keywords.$comment: Draft noun shown on the closed pill + open card glance label ('Independence — your Core').

vocabulary.$condition_note: DES_12 §5c RE-LOCK 2026-07-16: Overfueled/Balanced/Underfueled + Channel/Refill supersede Charged/Receptive/Fuel. Never surface engine terms (strong/weak, band, tgPattern).
vocabulary.chinese_glyphs: decorative only, never information-carrying (火 on the element hero is ornament; all meaning is in English labels)

archetype_fields.$comment: Locked per stem. arch_name/manifesto/keywords/who_you_are for the nine non-Gēng stems MUST come from DES_12's persona table — placeholders here are nulls, not suggestions.

stems.manifesto: Precision before intention. You are the Metal that cuts things clean.
stems.who_you_are: The verdict arrives before the conversation — evaluative precision, the standard that runs first. You trust your own counsel, begin without permission, and finish without rescue.

user_chart_fields.$comment: ALL computed by engine/energyRoles.js — the design never calculates. The reference chart below is the demo user baked into p6-journey.html (swap wholesale when binding real users).

schema.stem_id: one of the ten stems above
schema.roles: element → core | catalyst | friction (core can ALSO carry surplus friction, as Metal does here)
schema.major: elements flagged for the emphasis ring (largest need)
schema.missing: elements at 0% (dashed sliver on the wheel; MISSING label)
schema.cast_line: CAST FROM {year} · {month} {day} · {hour-range} {tz-abbr} — tz abbr from the birth city entered at onboarding (city → IANA zone)

user_chart_fields.wheel_placement_law: Core element always holds the TOP slot; the remaining four order high → low counter-clockwise starting from the slot at the Core's right. Node diameters 59/53/48/42/37 at seats −90°/−18°/54°/126°/198°, container 320×292.

element_screen_copy.$comment: Per-element reading-screen fields as built (source of truth: var ELD in p6-journey.html). face/kw pairs are the LAYER-2 face vocabulary — §7 of the design history README: NEEDS OWNER SIGN-OFF before production copy is locked. Copy below is the Gēng demo user's; per-user role/verdict lines re-bind from user_chart_fields.

example_fire.title: The forge you borrow, never own.
example_fire.verdict: Cast with none — borrow it daily · with Water & Wood.
example_fire.mean: The room is different before you speak — warmth as climate, light that changes what it touches.

element_screen_copy.all_five: read var ELD (p6-journey.html, ~line 1688) — verbatim strings for fire/water/wood/earth/metal

routes.$comment: Integration points — these buttons exist in the prototype with data-route attributes; wire to the app's existing pages.
routes.reading/energy/:element: element screen → 'Full reading' pill-cta. Destination: the existing per-energy reading pages (design reference: reference/elementum-d13-part2-readings.html)
routes.reading/daymaster: day-master screen → 'The full Day Master reading' pill-cta. Destination: the existing Day Master reading page
routes.in_prototype: identity-card float → 'Read the full Day Master →' navigates to the daymaster screen (data-go-float)
